experiment.title: Fix SIGINT exit code calculation in relay.js
experiment.hypothesis: The relay script incorrectly maps SIGINT to exit code 143 (128+15) instead of the conventional 130 (128+2). The signal handling logic assumes SIGTERM=15, but SIGINT should map to 2.
experiment.falsifier: Running the probe with the original code must return 143; after the edit, it must return 130.
experiment.intendedBenefit: Preserves the contract that relay.js exits with the child's status (130 for SIGINT), enabling correct agent termination behavior.

limits: A reported issue is not permission to contact its author, endorsement, demand validation or evidence that our product solves it.
